findings.title: 117 potential secret/password matches in source
findings.evidence: Includes default passwords, JWT_SECRET values, test tokens
findings.recommendation: Audit every match; rotate exposed secrets; replace defaults with env-driven values

findings.title: 16 potential API keys in source/env
findings.recommendation: Move all keys to vault/GitHub Secrets; rotate immediately; never commit real values

findings.title: Stripe secret key pattern found in committed file
findings.impact: Payment data breach, PCI scope expansion
findings.recommendation: Rotate Stripe key immediately; remove from git history

findings.title: Gallery and Management have dual backend codebases (Express + Cloudflare Worker)
findings.evidence: apps/gallery/backend/legacy/ and apps/management/backend/legacy/ coexist with Worker src/
findings.impact: Confusion, duplicate security surface, build ambiguity, maintenance burden
findings.recommendation: Archive legacy Express backends; route all traffic through CF Worker; update docs

findings.title: 18 `.env` files present in repository (not examples)
findings.impact: Risk of committed secrets; CI/CD exposure
findings.recommendation: Add all .env files to .gitignore, rotate any exposed secrets, move to vault

findings.title: 240 SQL migration files with duplicate prefixes across apps
findings.evidence: master has 103 migrations with 24 duplicate prefixes; master-cpp has 57 with 6 duplicates
findings.impact: Migration ordering conflicts, schema drift, failed deployments
findings.recommendation: Consolidate to single migration source; use timestamp-based IDs; add reversibility tests

findings.title: 13 production dependencies have version mismatches across apps
findings.evidence: Examples: lucide-react, @sentry/react, express, react-window, uuid, sharp
findings.impact: Inconsistent behavior, duplicate bundles, harder security patching
findings.recommendation: Align versions via pnpm catalog or workspace overrides; pin security-sensitive packages

findings.title: 13 TODO/FIXME comments related to security/auth
findings.evidence: Includes "TODO: Set up API authentication" and OAuth token staleness notes
findings.recommendation: Convert TODOs to tracked tickets; resolve P0/P1 security TODOs before release

findings.title: 7 apps missing tsconfig.json
findings.evidence: gallery, installer, management, master, moneytrash, touch, website
findings.impact: No TypeScript checking; runtime errors more likely
findings.recommendation: Add tsconfig.json to every app; run tsc --noEmit in CI

findings.title: 163 test files across entire monorepo
findings.impact: Coverage likely below 70% target for several apps
findings.recommendation: Add unit tests for services/utils; expand E2E to cover critical cross-app flows

findings.title: 10 dev dependencies have version mismatches
findings.impact: Inconsistent lint/typecheck behavior across CI jobs
findings.recommendation: Centralize dev toolchain versions in root package.json

findings.title: Repository bloat from runtime artifacts and duplicate images
findings.evidence: 32MB MSI, 14MB log, duplicate 9MB portfolio images across website/master
findings.impact: Slow clones, larger backups, CI cache pollution
findings.recommendation: Add pb_data/, *.msi, *.log to .gitignore; deduplicate assets via shared package
